messages:
deploybot: Deploy started: canary rollout for release v3.14.1-canary
deploybot: env=prod-usw2  slice=canary-5%  tag=rev_3.14.1-rc2  commit=abc1234f  artifacts=runtime:2.9.0,model:open-7b-q5
deploybot: smoke checks queued -> https://deployments.redwood-internal/canary/2956789012  :rocket:

maya: Watching dashboards. I'll check latency and error bands in 2 min
sam: saw a small error blip during initial requests, sending quick stats
sam: ```
canary=5%  window=2m
errors: 0.9% (baseline 0.2%)
95p latency: 312ms (baseline 220ms)
qps: 120
```
lee: ugh, 0.9% is borderline. Any stack traces?
sam: grabbing traces now, looks like reranker timeouts in a few pods, stack shows LRU miss + KV cache pressure
priya: @maya do we have KV cache metrics?
maya: kv_cache_evictions spike +50% around 2956789050, correlates with latency
priya: ok suggest pause promotion until we root cause. Can we step traffic back to 0%?
lee: agree. If it's cache pressure we can toggle kv_cache_enabled=false for canary nodes as a mitigation
sam: quick suggestion: pause promotion, pin rollout at current canary and test toggle on a single pod
deploybot: Promotion action: PAUSE (reason=observed_error_spike)  user=priya  ts=2956789130
deploybot: Canary pinned at tag=rev_3.14.1-rc2  slice=canary-5%  note="hold for investigation"
priya: applying kv_cache_enabled=false to one canary pod now (will update)
lee: thanks. if that helps we can gradually increase and monitor 1/5 -> 2/5 etc
(1 min later)
sam: quick perf after toggle:
sam: ```
canary=5%  window=1m
errors: 0.25%
95p latency: 230ms
kv_cache_evictions: down 80%
```
maya: looks much better. Nice quick mitigation.
priya: rolling the toggle to remaining canary pods now, step=2/5 -> 5/5
deploybot: Config update applied: kv_cache_enabled=false  target=canary  user=priya  ts=2956789275
lee: monitoring... metrics look back to baseline. Recommend gradual promotion to 15% then 50%
maya: agree. I'll watch evals for quality regressions while we ramp traffic
sam: no functional errors in traces after toggle, reranker tail stabilized
priya: initiate promote to 15%
deploybot: Traffic bumped: canary 5% -> 15%  initiated by priya  ts=2956789302
maya: checking eval sets—no diffs in safety/llm-output so far
lee: bump to 50% after 10m if green
(10m passes)
priya: green across the board, moving to 50%
deploybot: Traffic bumped: canary 15% -> 50%  initiated by priya  ts=2956789345
maya: no new regressions, latency stable, error rate 0.2%
lee: promote to full rollout in 10m unless we see anything
deploybot: Final promotion: canary -> stable 100%  tag=rev_3.14.1  commit=abc1234f  user=priya  ts=2956789399  :tada:
priya: Release note: v3.14.1 deployed to prod-usw2. Mitigation was kv_cache_enabled=false for canary nodes; rolled out cluster-wide. Follow-up: infra/kv team to investigate cache sizing.
maya: added follow-up ticket #INT-1428 to track root cause and long-term fix
lee: nice work everyone :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Oncall notified: pager duty incident cleared (pd-873)
